from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from experiments.synthetic_trainers.attention_layout import digest
from experiments.synthetic_trainers.persistence import PersistenceConfig
from experiments.synthetic_trainers.stability_comparison import hashes, verify_comparison
from experiments.synthetic_trainers.stability_recovery import describe
from experiments.synthetic_trainers.stability_recovery_series import timeline
from experiments.synthetic_trainers.stability_report import verify_archive
from experiments.synthetic_trainers.protocols.adamw_stability_20261002.budget_extension_guard import read_frozen, verify_child

protocol = Path('experiments/synthetic_trainers/protocols/adamw_stability_20261002')
stage, manifest = read_frozen()
run = verify_child(stage, manifest)
state = json.loads((stage / 'state.json').read_text())
worker = json.loads((stage.parent / 'bootstrap/budget300k-archive-worker.json').read_text())
assert state['status'] == 'complete' and state['completed_runs'] == 1
assert worker['status'] == 'budget300k_archives_ready_for_visual_review_and_commit'
archive = Path(worker['archive'])
comparison = Path(worker['comparison'])
summary = verify_archive(archive)
combined = verify_comparison(comparison)
report = json.loads((run / 'measurements.json').read_text())
parent = json.loads((Path(manifest['parent_source_directory']) / 'measurements.json').read_text())
assert report['completed_steps'] == 300000 and len(report['history']) == 1201
assert report['history'][:len(parent['history'])] == parent['history']
assert summary['parameters'] == 436104
for name in ('measurements.json', 'gradients.jsonl', 'diagnostics.jsonl', 'probes.jsonl'):
    assert (run / name).read_bytes() == (archive / name).read_bytes()
individual_hashes = hashes(archive)
assert individual_hashes == hashes(comparison / 'runs' / manifest['recipes'][0]['name'])
for name, count in (('probes.jsonl', 2400), ('diagnostics.jsonl', 3600), ('gradients.jsonl', 300000)):
    assert sum(1 for _ in (archive / name).open()) == count
protected = {name:value for key in ('source_hashes', 'analysis_and_driver_source_hashes', 'papers',
                                   'extension_source_hashes', 'recovery_source_hashes')
             for name,value in manifest[key].items()}
assert len(protected) == 39 and all(digest(name) == value for name,value in protected.items())
criterion = PersistenceConfig(**manifest['criterion'])
additional = protocol / 'budget300k-additional-metrics'
recovery = describe(report, criterion, window_steps=10000)
series = timeline(report, criterion, window_steps=10000)
for filename, expected in (('recovery-metrics.json', recovery), ('recovery-series.json', series)):
    assert json.loads((stage / filename).read_text()) == expected
    assert (stage / filename).read_bytes() == (additional / filename).read_bytes()
for name, value in json.loads((additional / 'artifact-hashes.json').read_text())['files'].items():
    assert digest(additional / name) == value
peaks = json.loads((stage / 'observed-extension-peaks.json').read_text())
for name, value in peaks.items():
    assert report[name] == max(parent[name], value)
    assert report['budget_extension_provenance']['extension_observed_peaks'][name] == value
assessment = summary['assessment']
joint = recovery['metrics']['joint']
assert assessment['tail_start_step'] == 250000 and assessment['tail_observations'] == 201
assert not assessment['persistent_final_performance'] and not assessment['stable_grokking']
assert not combined['ready_to_freeze_independent_confirmation']
assert 'torch' not in sys.modules
receipt = {
    'recorded_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'complete exploratory posthoc total-budget extension; delayed generalization and sampled recovery; no repeatability or permanent-stability claim',
    'verification_command': 'PYTHONPATH=. python3 /tmp/verify-budget300k-20261002.py',
    'completed_updates':300000, 'offline_verification_passed':True, 'Torch_imported':False,
    'complete_archive_verified_without_torch':True, 'complete_comparison_verified_without_torch':True,
    'canonical_observations':1201, 'neighbor_observations':2400,
    'diagnostic_observations':3600, 'dense_gradient_observations':300000,
    'original_measurement_and_raw_log_files_byte_equal_archive':True,
    'all_601_original_canonical_observations_preserved':True,
    'all_original_raw_log_prefixes_byte_preserved':True,
    'nested_individual_files_byte_identical':len(individual_hashes),
    'frozen_core_manuscript_extension_recovery_files_unchanged':39,
    'original_checkpoint_sha256':manifest['parent_checkpoint_sha256'],
    'final_checkpoint_sha256':digest(run / 'checkpoint.pt'),
    'archive_artifact_manifest_sha256':digest(archive / 'artifact-hashes.json'),
    'comparison_artifact_manifest_sha256':digest(comparison / 'artifact-hashes.json'),
    'complete_300000_recovery_metrics_equal_frozen_derivation':True,
    'complete_300000_recovery_series_equal_frozen_derivation':True,
    'peak_memory_matches_maximum_parent_and_extension':True,
    'assessment':assessment, 'gradient_trace':summary['gradient_trace'],
    'parameters':summary['parameters'], 'training_seconds':report['training_seconds'],
    'wall_seconds':report['wall_seconds'], 'diagnostic_seconds':report['diagnostic_seconds'],
    'peak_cuda_allocated_bytes':report['peak_cuda_allocated_bytes'],
    'peak_cuda_reserved_bytes':report['peak_cuda_reserved_bytes'],
    'budget_extension_provenance':report['budget_extension_provenance'],
    'joint_recovery':joint, 'whole_post_long_onset_series':series,
    'eligible_persistent_timing_support':0,
    'trainer_pid':135520, 'trainer_session':64768,
    'archive_worker_pid':135597, 'archive_worker_session':37682,
    'PNG_figures_visually_reviewed':False, 'PDF_figures_visually_reviewed':False,
}
(protocol / 'budget300k-result-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'completed_updates':300000,'tail_failures':assessment['tail_failures'],
                  'minimum_tail_heldout':assessment['tail_minimum_heldout_accuracy'],
                  'episodes':joint['episode_count'],'last_streak':joint['final_target_streak'],
                  'gradient_trace':summary['gradient_trace'],
                  'training_seconds':report['training_seconds'],'wall_seconds':report['wall_seconds'],
                  'peaks':peaks,'Torch_imported':False}))
